items.ar: الْحِزْبُ الْأَوَّلُ لَيْلَةَ الِاثْنَيْنِ
items.en: The First Part, Monday Night
items.translit: Al-hizb al-awwal laylat al-ithnayn

items.ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ. بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ.
items.en: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan. In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
items.translit: A'uzu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim. Bismillahir-rahmanir-rahim.

items.ar: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
items.en: May Allah's blessings and peace be upon our master and mawla Muhammad, and upon his family and companions.
items.translit: Sallallahu 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi wa sahbihi wa sallam.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and his wives and his descendants, just as You sent blessings upon our master and mawla Ibrahim, and bless our master and mawla Muhammad and his wives and his descendants, just as You blessed the family of our master and mawla Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi, kama sallayta 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Ibrahima, wa barik 'ala Sayyidina wa Mawlana Muhammadin wa azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi, kama barakta 'ala ali Sayyidina wa Mawlana Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and his wives and his descendants, just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim. And bless our master Muhammad and his wives and his descendants, just as You blessed our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi, kama sallayta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahim, wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa azwajihi wa zurriyyatihi, kama barakta 'ala ali Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family, just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed the family of our master Ibrahim, in all the worlds. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi, kama sallayta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin, kama barakta 'ala ali Sayyidina Ibrahima fil 'alamina, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa ali Sayyidina Muhammadin, kama sallayta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa ali Sayyidina Muhammadin, kama barakta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant and Your messenger.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'abdika wa rasulik.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim and upon the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama sallayta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed our master Ibrahim and the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَتَرَحَّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَرَحَّمْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, have mercy upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You had mercy upon our master Ibrahim and upon the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma watarahham 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama tarahhamta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَتَحَنَّنْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَحَنَّنْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, be gracious to our master Muhammad and to the family of our master Muhammad, just as You were gracious to our master Ibrahim and to the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma watahannan 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama tahannanta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا سَلَّمْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, grant peace to our master Muhammad and to the family of our master Muhammad, just as You granted peace to our master Ibrahim and to the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma wa sallim 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama sallamta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَارْحَمْ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا وَآلَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَرَحِمْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and have mercy on our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed, had mercy, and blessed our master Ibrahim and the family of our master Ibrahim, in all the worlds. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin warham Sayyidana Muhammadan wa ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama sallayta wa rahimta wa barakta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Ibrahima fil 'alamina, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad the Prophet, and his wives the Mothers of the Believers, and his descendants and the People of his House, just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin-nabiyyi wa azwajihi ummahatil-mu'minina wa dhurriyyatihi wa ahli baytihi kama sallayta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

lessons.title: The Quranic Command to Bless the Prophet

items.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ.
items.en: Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet.
items.translit: Innallaha wa mala'ikatahu yusalluna 'alan-nabi.

items.ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا.
items.en: O you who believe, send blessings upon him and greet him with peace.
items.translit: Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu sallu 'alayhi wa sallimu tasliman.

items.ar: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبِّي وَسَعْدَيْكَ، صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ الْبَرِّ الرَّحِيمِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ وَالنَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ وَمَا سَبَّحَ لَكَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَسَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: At Your service, O Allah my Lord, and at Your good pleasure! May the blessings of Allah the Good, the Merciful, and of the angels brought near, and the prophets, and the truthful, and the martyrs, and the righteous, and everything that glorifies You, O Lord of the worlds, be upon our master Muhammad, the servant of Allah, the seal of the prophets and master of the messengers, and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Labbayka Allahumma rabbi wa sa'dayk, salawatullahil-barrir-rahimi wal-mala'ikatil-muqarrabina wan-nabiyyina was-siddiqina wash-shuhada'i was-salihina wa ma sabbaha laka min shay'in ya rabbal-'alamin, 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'abdillahi khatamin-nabiyyina wa sayyidil-mursalin, wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama sallayta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

lessons.title: Blessings on the Prophet's Family and Companions

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَأَوْلَادِهِ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَأَصْهَارِهِ وَأَنْصَارِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ وَمُحِبِّيهِ وَأُمَّتِهِ وَعَلَيْنَا مَعَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, and upon his family, his companions, his children, his wives, his descendants, the people of his house, his in-laws, his helpers, his followers, those who love him, and his nation, and upon us together with all of them, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi wa ashabihi wa awladihi wa azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi wa ahli baytihi wa ashharihi wa ansarihi wa ashya'ihi wa muhibbihi wa ummatihi wa 'alayna ma'ahum ajma'ina ya arhamar-rahimin.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَمَرْتَنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ كَمَا تُحِبُّ أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many times as those who have sent blessings upon him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many times as those who have not sent blessings upon him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad just as You commanded us to send blessings upon him, and send blessings upon him as You love blessings to be sent upon him.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada man salla 'alayhi, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada man lam yusalli 'alayhi, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin kama amartana bis-salati 'alayhi, wa salli 'alayhi kama tuhibbu an yusalla 'alayh.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَمَرْتَنَا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You commanded us to send blessings upon him.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama amartana an nusalliya 'alayh.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as he deserves.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama huwa ahluh.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَاهُ لَهُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as You love and are pleased for him.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama tuhibbu wa tardhahu lah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبَّ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، وَآتِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا الدَّرَجَةَ وَالْوَسِيلَةَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ.
items.en: O Allah, O Lord of our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and grant our master Muhammad the rank and the wasila in Paradise.
items.translit: Allahumma ya Rabba Sayyidina Muhammadin wa ali Sayyidina Muhammadin, salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa ali Sayyidina Muhammadin, wa ati Sayyidana Muhammadanid-darajata wal-wasilata fil-jannah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبَّ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، اجْزِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ.
items.en: O Allah, O Lord of our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, reward our master Muhammad, may Allah's blessings and peace be upon him, as he deserves.
items.translit: Allahumma ya Rabba Sayyidina Muhammadin wa ali Sayyidina Muhammadin, ijzi Sayyidana Muhammadan sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama ma huwa ahluh.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad and upon the People of his House.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ahli baytih.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ شَيْءٌ، وَارْحَمْ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا وَآلَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ شَيْءٌ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ الْبَرَكَةِ شَيْءٌ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ السَّلَامِ شَيْءٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad until nothing remains of blessing; and have mercy upon our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until nothing remains of mercy; and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until nothing remains of blessing; and send peace upon our master Muhammad until nothing remains of peace.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin hatta la yabqa minas-salati shay', warham Sayyidana Muhammadan wa ala Sayyidina Muhammadin hatta la yabqa minar-rahmati shay', wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin hatta la yabqa minal-barakati shay', wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin hatta la yabqa minas-salami shay'.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْأَوَّلِينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي النَّبِيِّينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the first, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the last, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the prophets, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the messengers, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad in the Highest Assembly until the Day of Judgment.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin fil-awwalin, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin fil-akhirin, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin fin-nabiyyin, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin fil-mursalin, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin fil-mala'il-a'la ila yawmid-din.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ آتِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالشَّرَفَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الْكَبِيرَةَ.
items.en: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad the wasila, the excellence, the honor, and the great rank.
items.translit: Allahumma ati Sayyidana Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadhilata wash-sharafa wad-darajatal-kabirah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي آمَنْتُ بِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَلَمْ أَرَهُ، فَلَا تَحْرِمْنِي فِي الْجِنَانِ رُؤْيَتَهُ، وَارْزُقْنِي صُحْبَتَهُ، وَتَوَفَّنِي عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ، وَأَسْقِنِي مِنْ حَوْضِهِ مَشْرَبًا رَوِيًّا سَائِغًا هَنِيئًا لَا أَظْمَأُ بَعْدَهُ أَبَدًا، إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
items.en: O Allah, I have believed in our master Muhammad without having seen him, so do not deprive me in Paradise of seeing him, and grant me his companionship, and take my soul following his way, and give me to drink from his Pool a satisfying, pleasant, wholesome drink after which I will never thirst again. Indeed, You are able to do all things.
items.translit: Allahumma inni amantu bi-Sayyidina Muhammadin wa lam arahu fala tahrimni fil-jinani ru'yatahu, warzuqni suhbatahu, wa tawaffani 'ala millatihi, wa asqini min hawdihi mashraban rawiyyan sa'ighan hani'an la azma'u ba'dahu abadan, innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَبْلِغْ رُوحَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِنِّي تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَامًا.
items.en: O Allah, convey to the soul of our master Muhammad, from me, a greeting and peace.
items.translit: Allahumma abligh ruha Sayyidina Muhammadin minni tahiyyatan wa salama.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَكَمَا آمَنْتُ بِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَلَمْ أَرَهُ فَلَا تَحْرِمْنِي فِي الْجِنَانِ رُؤْيَتَهُ.
items.en: O Allah, and just as I believed in our master Muhammad without having seen him, do not deprive me in Paradise of seeing him.
items.translit: Allahumma wa kama amantu bi-Sayyidina Muhammadin wa lam arahu fala tahrimni fil-jinani ru'yatah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَةَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الْكُبْرَى، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ الْعُلْيَا، وَآتِهِ سُؤْلَهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ وَالْأُولَى، كَمَا آتَيْتَ سَيِّدَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَسَيِّدَنَا مُوسَى.
items.en: O Allah, accept the great intercession of our master Muhammad, raise his lofty rank, and grant him his request in the Hereafter and in this life, just as You granted our master Ibrahim and our master Musa.
items.translit: Allahumma taqabbal shafa'ata Sayyidina Muhammadinil-kubra, warfa' darajatahul-'ulya, wa atihi su'lahu fil-akhirati wal-ula, kama atayta Sayyidana Ibrahima wa Sayyidana Musa.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim and upon the family of our master Ibrahim, and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed our master Ibrahim and the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama sallayta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Ibrahima, wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُولِكَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings, peace, and grace upon our master Muhammad, Your prophet and Your messenger.
items.translit: Allahumma salli wa sallim wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin-nabiyyika wa rasulik.

items.ar: وَسَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِكَ وَصَفِيِّكَ، وَسَيِّدِنَا مُوسَى كَلِيمِكَ وَنَجِيِّكَ.
items.en: And upon our master Ibrahim, Your intimate friend and Your chosen one, and our master Musa, the one You spoke to directly and confided in.
items.translit: Wa Sayyidina Ibrahima khalilika wa safiyyika, wa Sayyidina Musa kalimika wa najiyyik.

items.ar: وَسَيِّدِنَا عِيسَى رُوحِكَ وَكَلِمَتِكَ، وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ مَلَائِكَتِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ وَأَنْبِيَائِكَ وَخِيَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَأَصْفِيَائِكَ وَخَاصَّتِكَ وَأَوْلِيَائِكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ أَرْضِكَ وَسَمَائِكَ.
items.en: And our master 'Isa, Your spirit and Your word, and upon all Your angels and Your messengers and Your prophets and the elect of Your creation and Your chosen ones and Your special ones and Your saints, among the people of Your earth and Your heaven.
items.translit: Wa Sayyidina 'Isa ruhika wa kalimatika, wa 'ala jami'i mala'ikatika wa rusulika wa anbiya'ika wa khiyaratika min khalqika wa asfiya'ika wa khassatika wa awliya'ika min ahli ardhika wa sama'ik.

items.ar: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ وَكَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ، وَكُلَّمَا ذَكَرَهُ الذَّاكِرُونَ وَغَفَلَ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِ الْغَافِلُونَ، وَعَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَعِتْرَتِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا.
items.en: And may Allah send blessings upon our master Muhammad, as many as His creation, and to the extent of His own pleasure, and the ink of His words, and as he deserves, and every time the remembering ones remember him and the heedless ones are heedless of remembering him, and upon the People of his House and his pure family, and grant abundant peace.
items.translit: Wa sallallahu 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada khalqihi wa ridha'a nafsihi wa midada kalimatihi wa kama huwa ahluhu, wa kullama dhakarahudh-dhakiruna wa ghafala 'an dhikrihil-ghafiluna, wa 'ala ahli baytihi wa 'itratihit-tahirina wa sallama taslima.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالْمُرْسَلِينَ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ وَجَمِيعِ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، عَدَدَ مَا أَمْطَرَتِ السَّمَاءُ مُنْذُ بَنَيْتَهَا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَنْبَتَتِ الْأَرْضُ مُنْذُ دَحَوْتَهَا.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his wives and his descendants and upon all the prophets and messengers and the angels brought near and all of Allah's righteous servants, as many times as the sky has rained since You built it, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many times as the earth has grown since You spread it out.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi wa 'ala jami'in-nabiyyina wal-mursalina wal-mala'ikatil-muqarrabina wa jami'i 'ibadillahis-salihina, 'adada ma amtaratis-sama'u mundhu banaytaha, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma anbatatil-ardhu mundhu dahawtaha.

items.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النُّجُومِ فِي السَّمَاءِ فَإِنَّكَ أَحْصَيْتَهَا.
items.en: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many times as the stars in the sky, for indeed You have counted them.
items.translit: Wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adadan-nujumi fis-sama'i fa innaka ahsaytaha.

items.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا تَنَفَّسَتِ الْأَرْوَاحُ مُنْذُ خَلَقْتَهَا.
items.en: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many times as the souls have breathed since You created them.
items.translit: Wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma tanaffasatil-arwahu mundhu khalaqtaha.

items.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ وَمَا تَخْلُقُ وَمَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ وَأَضْعَافَ ذَلِكَ.
items.en: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many times as what You have created and what You will create and what Your knowledge encompasses, and multiples of that.
items.translit: Wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma khalaqta wa ma takhluqu wa ma ahata bihi 'ilmuka wa adh'afa dhalik.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ وَرِضَا نَفْسِكَ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ وَمَبْلَغَ عِلْمِكَ وَآيَاتِكَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon them as many as Your creation, and to the extent of Your own pleasure, and the weight of Your Throne, and the ink of Your words, and the extent of Your knowledge and Your signs.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'alayhim 'adada khalqika wa ridha'a nafsika wa zinata 'arshika wa midada kalimatika wa mablagha 'ilmika wa ayatik.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَاةً تَفُوقُ وَتَفْضُلُ صَلَاةَ الْمُصَلِّينَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الْخَلْقِ أَجْمَعِينَ كَفَضْلِكَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ.
items.en: O Allah, send upon them blessings that surpass and exceed the blessings of all who send blessings upon them from all of creation, just as You are superior over all of Your creation.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'alayhim salatan tafuqu wa tafdhulu salatal-musallina 'alayhim minal-khalqi ajma'ina kafadhlika 'ala jami'i khalqik.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَاتٍ دَائِمَةً مُسْتَمِرَّةَ الدَّوَامِ عَلَى مَرِّ اللَّيَالِي وَالْأَيَّامِ، مُتَّصِلَةَ الدَّوَامِ لَا انْقِضَاءَ لَهَا وَلَا انْصِرَامَ عَلَى مَرِّ اللَّيَالِي وَالْأَيَّامِ، عَدَدَ كُلِّ وَابِلٍ وَطَلٍّ.
items.en: O Allah, send upon them blessings that are everlasting, continuous, enduring through the passing of nights and days, unceasing and unending through the passing of nights and days, as many as every downpour and every drizzle.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'alayhim salawatin da'imatan mustamirratad-dawami 'ala marril-layali wal-ayyami, muttasilatad-dawami lan-qidha'a laha wa lan-sirama 'ala marril-layali wal-ayyami, 'adada kulli wabilin wa tall.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ وَسَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِكَ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَأَصْفِيَائِكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ أَرْضِكَ وَسَمَائِكَ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ وَرِضَا نَفْسِكَ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ وَمُنْتَهَى عِلْمِكَ وَزِنَةَ جَمِيعِ مَخْلُوقَاتِكَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your prophet, and our master Ibrahim, Your intimate friend, and upon all Your prophets and Your chosen ones among the people of Your earth and Your heaven, as many as Your creation, and to the extent of Your own pleasure, and the weight of Your Throne, and the ink of Your words, and the utmost of Your knowledge, and the weight of all Your creations.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin-nabiyyika wa Sayyidina Ibrahima khalilika wa 'ala jami'i anbiya'ika wa asfiya'ika min ahli ardhika wa sama'ika, 'adada khalqika wa ridha'a nafsika wa zinata 'arshika wa midada kalimatika wa muntaha 'ilmika wa zinata jami'i makhluqatik.

items.ar: حَفِظَ عَهْدَهُ وَذِمَّتَهُ وَنَصَرَ حِزْبَهُ وَدَعْوَتَهُ، وَكَثَّرَ تَابِعِيهِ وَفِرْقَتَهُ، وَوَفَّى جَمَاعَتَهُ، وَلَمْ يُخَالِفْ سَبِيلَهُ وَسُنَّتَهُ.
items.en: He kept his covenant and his trust, gave victory to his party and his call, increased his followers and his group, fulfilled his community, and did not deviate from his path and his way.
items.translit: Hafiza 'ahdahu wa dhimmatahu wa nasara hizbahu wa da'watahu, wa kaththara tabi'ihi wa firqatahu, wa waffa jama'atahu, wa lam yukhalif sabilahu wa sunnatah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الِاسْتِمْسَاكَ بِسُنَّتِهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الِانْحِرَافِ عَمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ.
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for firm adherence to his way, and I seek refuge in You from deviating from what he brought.
items.translit: Allahumma inni as'alukal-istimsaka bi-sunnatihi wa a'udhu bika minal-inhirafi 'amma ja'a bih.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ نَبِيُّكَ وَرَسُولُكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اسْتَعَاذَكَ مِنْهُ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ نَبِيُّكَ وَرَسُولُكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for the good that our master Muhammad, Your prophet and Your messenger, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, asked You for, and I seek refuge in You from the evil that our master Muhammad, Your prophet and Your messenger, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, sought refuge in You from.
items.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka min khayri ma sa'alaka minhu Sayyiduna Muhammadun-nabiyyuka wa rasuluka sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, wa a'udhu bika min sharri mastu'adhaka minhu Sayyiduna Muhammadun-nabiyyuka wa rasuluka sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنْ شَرِّ الْفِتَنِ وَعَافِنِي مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمِحَنِ وَأَصْلِحْ مِنِّي مَا ظَهَرَ وَمَا بَطَنَ وَنَقِّ قَلْبِي مِنَ الْحِقْدِ وَالْحَسَدِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ عَلَيَّ طَبَاعَةً لِأَحَدٍ.
items.en: O Allah, protect me from the evil of trials, and grant me well-being from all afflictions, and set right of me what is apparent and what is hidden, and cleanse my heart of malice and envy, and do not place upon me any hold for anyone.
items.translit: Allahumma-'simni min sharril-fitani wa 'afini min jami'il-mihani wa aslih minni ma zahara wa ma batana wa naqqi qalbi minal-hiqdi wal-hasadi wa la taj'al 'alayya taba'atan li-ahad.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْأَخْذَ بِأَحْسَنِ مَا تَعْلَمُ وَتَرْكَ السَّيِّئِ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ التَّكَفُّلَ بِالرِّزْقِ وَالزُّهْدَ فِي الْكَفَافِ، وَالْمَخْرَجَ بِالْبَيَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ شُبْهَةٍ، وَالْفَلَجَ بِالصَّوَابِ فِي كُلِّ حُجَّةٍ، وَالْعَدْلَ فِي الْغَضَبِ وَالرِّضَا، وَالتَّسْلِيمَ لِمَا يَجْرِي بِهِ الْقَضَاءُ، وَالِاقْتِصَادَ فِي الْفَقْرِ وَالْغِنَى، وَالتَّوَاضُعَ فِي الْقَوْلِ وَالْفِعْلِ، وَالصِّدْقَ فِي الْجِدِّ وَالْهَزْلِ.
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for taking the best of what You know and leaving the evil of what You know, and I ask You for the guarantee of sustenance, and contentment with sufficiency, and a clear way out from every doubt, and success through what is right in every argument, and justice in anger and in contentment, and submission to whatever is decreed, and moderation in poverty and in wealth, and humility in word and deed, and truthfulness in seriousness and in jest.
items.translit: Allahumma inni as'alukal-akhdha bi-ahsani ma ta'lamu wa tarkas-sayyi'i ma ta'lamu, wa as'alukat-takafful bir-rizqi waz-zuhda fil-kafaf, wal-makhraja bil-bayani min kulli shubhatin, wal-falaja bis-sawabi fi kulli hujjatin, wal-'adla fil-ghadhabi war-ridha, wat-taslima lima yajri bihil-qadha'u, wal-iqtisada fil-faqri wal-ghina, wat-tawadu'a fil-qawli wal-fi'li, was-sidqa fil-jiddi wal-hazl.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ لِي ذُنُوبًا فِيمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ وَذُنُوبًا فِيمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَلْقِكَ.
items.en: O Allah, I have sins between me and You, and sins between me and Your creation.
items.translit: Allahumma inna li dhunuban fima bayni wa baynaka wa dhunuban fima bayni wa bayna khalqik.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ مَا كَانَ لَكَ مِنْهَا فَاغْفِرْهُ، وَمَا كَانَ مِنْهَا لِخَلْقِكَ فَتَحَمَّلْهُ عَنِّي وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ، إِنَّكَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ.
items.en: O Allah, whatever of them is owed to You, forgive it, and whatever of them is owed to Your creation, bear it on my behalf, and enrich me by Your grace, for indeed You are vast in forgiveness.
items.translit: Allahumma ma kana laka minha faghfirhu, wa ma kana minha li-khalqika fatahammalhu 'anni wa aghnini bifadhlika, innaka wasi'ul-maghfirah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ نَوِّرْ بِالْعِلْمِ قَلْبِي، وَاسْتَعْمِلْ بِطَاعَتِكَ بَدَنِي، وَخَلِّصْ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ سِرِّي، وَاشْغَلْ بِالِاعْتِبَارِ فِكْرِي، وَقِنِي شَرَّ وَسَاوِسِ الشَّيْطَانِ، وَأَجِرْنِي مِنْهُ يَا رَحْمَٰنُ حَتَّى لَا يَكُونَ لَهُ عَلَيَّ سُلْطَانٌ.
items.en: O Allah, illuminate my heart with knowledge, and employ my body in Your obedience, and free my innermost self from trials, and occupy my thought with reflection, and protect me from the evil whispers of Satan, and grant me protection from him, O Most Merciful, so that he has no power over me.
items.translit: Allahumma nawwir bil-'ilmi qalbi, wasta'mil bi-ta'atika badani, wa khallis minal-fitani sirri, wash-ghal bil-i'tibari fikri, wa qini sharra wasawisish-shaytan, wa ajirni minhu ya rahmanu hatta la yakuna lahu 'alayya sultan.
